adaptations: Replace JDBC with typed WIT raw-row CRUD and explicit owned/borrowed persistence sessions.
Keep join, name ordering, insert/update decisions, form parsing, transient key qualification, controller state and change-before-effect order in shared guest Clojure source.
Render typed view models instead of Ring/Selmer HTML; no HTTP or browser frontend.
Replace JVM Long/parseLong with exact core parse-long plus structured failure for nonempty malformed strings.
Track changes per stable host session key rather than a single process-wide atom.
Resource close uses a reader-conditional adapter; protocol/record IFn spelling follows the platform.
Absent text form fields remain absent on updates; explicit null fields remain null.
JSON persistence is an explicit SQLite adapter, with a synchronous single-writer session contract.
Seed rows through explicit typed requests instead of original SQL startup DDL/population; preserve the department_id NOT NULL storage constraint.
